futuretek.configuration.title: FutureTek Settings
gamerule.futuretekAbandonedFactory.descr: A ruined factory with one of every FutureTek machine, to repair
gui.futuretek.deposit_all_tip: Moves into the chest every item of your inventory that the chest already contains
gui.futuretek.electric_enchanter.button2: Power 30 (like a full enchanting table) · 9 levels · 3 lapis · 200,000 TU
gui.futuretek.enchant_researcher.status0: Put an Enchantment Archive in the first slot
gui.futuretek.enchanter_no_archive: Archive in the 3rd slot = choose the enchantment
gui.futuretek.enchanter_nothing: No known enchantment fits this item
gui.futuretek.enchanter_put_item: Put an item or a book
gui.futuretek.filter_hint: Click with an item to add it, empty hand to remove
gui.futuretek.forget.hint: Forgets everything and learns again from what is in the chest now
gui.futuretek.keep_one.hint: YES: the terminal and the auto crafter always leave 1 item of each type in this chest
gui.futuretek.kiln_hint: Every %2$s seconds: up to %1$s logs become charcoal
gui.futuretek.laser_turret.button0.hint: Only monsters / all creatures (never players, pets, villagers or named ones)
gui.futuretek.mob_incubator.status0: Put a filled sampler in me
gui.futuretek.mole_state.at_home: At home: unloading / waiting for fuel
gui.futuretek.mole_state.idle: Ready: place it next to a chest and press Start
gui.futuretek.mole_state.stuck: Stuck: something is in the way
gui.futuretek.reactor_maintainer.status0: Touch a reactor core or chamber
gui.futuretek.reactor_more_columns: Attach Reactor Chambers to the core to unlock these columns
gui.futuretek.robot_state.2: needs a tool (put one in its chest)
gui.futuretek.robot_state.3: CHEST FULL: empty it, then tell it to continue
gui.futuretek.robot_state.4: no chest: put one next to the dock or link one with the panel
gui.futuretek.robot_state.5: job finished (tell it to continue for more)
message.futuretek.builder_no_block: Hold a block in your off hand
message.futuretek.controller_chest: The robot will bring everything to the chest at %s %s %s
message.futuretek.controller_dock: This is now the robot's charging dock
message.futuretek.controller_far: The robot can't be reached (too far or unloaded)
message.futuretek.controller_linked: Panel linked to the robot (%s). Now right-click its chest or dock.
message.futuretek.controller_none: Right-click a robot first to link it
message.futuretek.core_no_chest: Logistics Core: place a chest touching the core (it becomes the main chest)
message.futuretek.core_no_pipes: Logistics Core: connect it to a logistic pipe
message.futuretek.core_ok: Logistics Core active: %s connected chests · energy %s TU
message.futuretek.core_unpowered: Logistics Core: NO ENERGY (connect a cable)
message.futuretek.dowsing: Essence in the area: %s · most valuable: %s (%s)
message.futuretek.edge_missing: The Crystal Edge dimension is not available
message.futuretek.enchanter_incompatible: Not compatible with the enchantments it already has (or already at that level)
message.futuretek.enchanter_missing: You need %s levels, %s lapis and %sk TU
message.futuretek.essence_missing_cmd: Items without an Essence value: %s (with value: %s). List written to %s
message.futuretek.factory_where: An abandoned FutureTek factory is near spawn: entrance at %s %s %s. Bring it back to life!
message.futuretek.multimeter.network: Network: %s cables, %s connections, max %s TU/t, last tick %s TU
message.futuretek.no_network: Place this next to an item conduit
message.futuretek.quarry_status.ejecting: Quarry: digging layer Y=%s · no room for the items: throwing them out the top (put a chest or pipe on it)
message.futuretek.quarry_status.frame: Quarry: building the frame · energy %2$s TU
message.futuretek.quarry_status.full: Quarry: THE CHEST IS FULL · empty it or connect a bigger chest / pipes
message.futuretek.quarry_status.no_energ: Quarry: WAITING FOR ENERGY (%2$s TU, needs %3$s per block). A solar panel is too slow: use generators or more panels
message.futuretek.quarry_status.paused: Quarry: paused by a redstone signal
message.futuretek.quarry_status.working: Quarry: digging layer Y=%s · energy %2$s TU · area %4$sx%5$s
message.futuretek.reactor_danger: REACTOR DANGER: heat over 70%! Turn it off (redstone) or add cooling before it explodes!
message.futuretek.reactor_scram: REACTOR EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN: overheating! Fuel rods destroyed.
message.futuretek.robot_infinite: Infinite Core installed: this robot never runs out of energy
message.futuretek.robot_no_dock: No charging dock: this robot will not recharge (place it on a dock)
message.futuretek.shelter_in_the_way: Someone is standing where the walls go: move closer to the core
message.futuretek.shelter_no_energy: Not enough energy: each house needs %s TU. Recharge it!
message.futuretek.shelter_no_space: No room: it needs free flat ground 7x7, 4 blocks high
message.futuretek.shelter_part: It's part of the shelter: break the core to remove the house
tooltip.futuretek.advanced_crusher: Like the Crusher, but 4x faster (uses more energy)
tooltip.futuretek.advanced_generator: Burns fuel: 64 TU/t, fuel lasts longer
tooltip.futuretek.analyzer_conduit:
Learns what is in the chest it touches and sends it only those items
Put 1 sample item in the chest · right-click: extra filter, Keep 1, Forget
tooltip.futuretek.arcane_hourglass:
Right-click: on/off · Machines, furnaces and plants within 4 blocks work 4x faster
4 Essence per second
tooltip.futuretek.ardorite_armor: Never breaks · Full set: no fall damage, fire immunity, -50% damage, water breathing
tooltip.futuretek.ardorite_axe:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.ardorite_hammer:
Never breaks · always digs 5x5 (stone, dirt, sand...)
Hold Shift: one block only
tooltip.futuretek.ardorite_hoe:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.ardorite_pickaxe:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.ardorite_shovel:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.area_marker: Place one next to the Quarry and one at the opposite corner (same height, up to 64 blocks)
tooltip.futuretek.attractor_ring: Right-click: on/off · Pulls items and XP within 8 blocks
tooltip.futuretek.auto_crafter: Set a recipe: crafts with items from the network (on request or to keep a stock)
tooltip.futuretek.auto_fertilizer: Uses bone meal on the plants in a 9x9 area · 60 TU each
tooltip.futuretek.battery_box: Stores 40,000 TU · output from the front
tooltip.futuretek.battery_box_2: Stores 600,000 TU · output from the front
tooltip.futuretek.battery_box_3: Stores 10,000,000 TU · output from the front
tooltip.futuretek.builder_wand:
Hold a block in your off hand. Right-click: places a 3x3 layer (Shift: 1 block)
Blocks are paid in Essence, not taken from your inventory
tooltip.futuretek.chainsaw: Fast axe, cuts whole trees · 50 TU per block
tooltip.futuretek.charcoal_kiln: Logs → charcoal, 16 every 10 seconds, no fuel
tooltip.futuretek.chemical_bath:
ORE TRIPLING, step 1: raw ore + water → 3 purified crushed ore
Fill it with a water bucket. Then use the Thermal Centrifuge
tooltip.futuretek.crusher: Raw ore → 2 dusts (ore doubling). Also: ingots → dust, cobblestone → gravel...
tooltip.futuretek.diamond_drill:
Pickaxe + shovel, diamond level · 80 TU per block
Shift + right-click: 3x3 mode
tooltip.futuretek.dimensional_satchel:
Right-click: opens your personal 54-slot storage
Every satchel opens the SAME storage, kept after death
tooltip.futuretek.dissolve_slot: Put an item here to dissolve it into Essence and learn it
tooltip.futuretek.dowsing_rod: Right-click a block: shows how much Essence is in the 3x3 area behind it (8 deep)
tooltip.futuretek.electric_drill:
Pickaxe + shovel, iron level · 50 TU per block
Recharge it in a Battery Box
tooltip.futuretek.electric_empty: Out of energy: recharge it in a Battery Box
tooltip.futuretek.electric_enchanter:
Enchants with fewer experience levels, using a lot of energy
Level I: 2 levels · II: 5 levels · III: 9 levels
tooltip.futuretek.electric_furnace: A furnace that runs on energy instead of coal
tooltip.futuretek.electric_lamp:
Bright light (15) while it has energy · 2 TU/t
Lamps that touch share the energy: connect one to a cable
tooltip.futuretek.ember_ring:
In your inventory: immune to fire and lava
Right-click: throws a fireball (16 Essence)
tooltip.futuretek.enchant_archive:
Electronic list of the enchantments you know. Fill it in the Enchantment Researcher,
then put it in the Electric Enchanter to choose an exact enchantment
tooltip.futuretek.enchant_researcher:
Slot 1: Enchantment Archive · slot 2: an enchanted book (or item) to read instantly
With energy and time it discovers new enchantments by itself (1 minute, 60,000 TU each)
tooltip.futuretek.energy_switch:
Lets energy through (out of the front) only with a redstone signal
Put a lever on it to turn your lights on and off
tooltip.futuretek.essence_not_creatable: Can be dissolved, but not created with Essence
tooltip.futuretek.exo_mk1.boots: Jump boost I, half fall damage
tooltip.futuretek.exo_mk3.boots: Jump boost III, no fall damage
tooltip.futuretek.exo_mk3.helmet: Night vision, water breathing, feeds you
tooltip.futuretek.extractor_conduit: Pulls 8 items/second out of the container it touches
tooltip.futuretek.frost_ring:
In your inventory: water freezes under your feet
Right-click: freezes water and lava around you (32 Essence)
tooltip.futuretek.growth_accelerator: Makes crops around it grow faster (energy)
tooltip.futuretek.infinite_core: Right-click a robot: it never runs out of energy
tooltip.futuretek.kinetic_lens:
Right-click: digs a sphere where you look (up to 64 blocks)
8 Essence per block
tooltip.futuretek.laser_turret:
Hits creatures in a 7x7 area (from 1 below to 3 above) · 150 TU per hit
They drop items and experience as if you killed them
Items go into a chest touching the turret
tooltip.futuretek.light_panel: Thin lamp for floors, walls and ceilings · 2 TU/t
tooltip.futuretek.logistics_core:
Needs energy. The chest touching it becomes the MAIN chest:
items in it are sent automatically to their destinations
tooltip.futuretek.memory_gem: Right-click: stores ALL your experience · Shift + right-click: gives it back
tooltip.futuretek.miner_bag: Right-click: open · Shift + right-click: auto-collect on/off
tooltip.futuretek.mining_mole:
Digs by itself and comes back to the chest next to where you placed it
The area starts at the mole and grows away from the chest (radius 1 = 3x3)
Fuel: coal, charcoal, logs...
tooltip.futuretek.mob_incubator:
Put a filled Creature Sampler inside: that creature appears on top
6000 TU each · more energy = more often (max 6 nearby)
tooltip.futuretek.mob_sampler: Right-click a creature to take a sample
tooltip.futuretek.network_terminal: Shows everything in the chests of the network · take items · request crafts
tooltip.futuretek.nocturnite_armor: Never breaks · Full set: no fall damage, fire immunity
tooltip.futuretek.nocturnite_axe:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.nocturnite_hammer:
Never breaks · always digs 3x3 (stone, dirt, sand...)
Hold Shift: one block only
tooltip.futuretek.nocturnite_hoe:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.nocturnite_pickaxe:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.nocturnite_shovel:
Never breaks · Shift + right-click in the air: 3x3 area mode
(hold Shift while digging: one block only)
tooltip.futuretek.nuclear_tnt:
Light it like TNT: after 10 seconds it erases a huge sphere (radius 32)
Can be turned off in the config
tooltip.futuretek.omniscience_tome: Right-click: you learn EVERY item with an Essence value (consumed)
tooltip.futuretek.ore_scanner: Right-click: finds ores in a %sx%s area around you, down to %s blocks deep
tooltip.futuretek.planter:
Tills the dirt and plants seeds in a 9x9 area at its own level
Use it with a Harvester
tooltip.futuretek.plasma_saber: 13 damage while charged (250 TU per hit), 3 when empty
tooltip.futuretek.pulse_rifle: Right-click: energy beam up to 32 blocks, 8 damage · 400 TU per shot
tooltip.futuretek.quarry:
Digs a big area down to the bottom of the world · 64 TU per block
More energy = faster (up to 8 blocks per tick)
Area: one Area Marker next to it + one at the opposite corner
Output: chest/pipe touching it (top first), otherwise it throws the items out the top · right-click: status
tooltip.futuretek.reactor.coolant_cell: Absorbs up to 10,000 heat from adjacent rods. When full it becomes Spent
tooltip.futuretek.reactor.coolant_cell_3: Absorbs up to 30,000 heat. When full it becomes Spent
tooltip.futuretek.reactor.coolant_cell_6: Absorbs up to 60,000 heat. When full it becomes Spent
tooltip.futuretek.reactor.fuel_rod: Fuel: more energy and MUCH more heat when next to other rods
tooltip.futuretek.reactor.heat_vent: Takes heat from adjacent rods, removes 12 heat/s
tooltip.futuretek.reactor_chamber: Attach it to the Reactor Core: +1 column of slots · cables and pipes can connect to it
tooltip.futuretek.reactor_core:
Needs a redstone signal (lever) to run · 6 rows x 3 columns
Every Reactor Chamber touching it adds a column (up to 9) · at 100% heat it EXPLODES
tooltip.futuretek.reactor_maintainer:
Touching the reactor: swaps hot coolant cells, vents and depleted rods with fresh ones from its slots
Touching water: refills spent coolant cells by itself
tooltip.futuretek.repair_talisman: In your inventory: slowly repairs all your tools and armor
tooltip.futuretek.repulsion_lantern: Keeps monsters and their projectiles away (8 blocks)
tooltip.futuretek.robot:
Right-click a Charging Dock to turn it on: it always uses that dock and the chest next to it
Give it a pickaxe / axe / hoe (right-click it with the tool) · empty hand: change job
Shift + right-click: pick it up · Infinite Core: never needs charging
tooltip.futuretek.robot_controller:
Right-click a robot: link it · then right-click a chest (even far away): the robot uses that chest
Right-click a charging dock: new dock · right-click in the air: status · Shift + right-click in the air: continue
tooltip.futuretek.robot_dock: Charges the robot standing on it · put a chest next to it for the robot's loot
tooltip.futuretek.shelter_core:
Place it on flat ground: it builds a small house around itself
(bed, crafting table, furnace, door). Break the core and the house disappears
Recharge it in the Accumulator Bench like an energy cell
tooltip.futuretek.shifting_stone: Crafting: converts metals. Right-click: transforms blocks (Shift: 3x3)
tooltip.futuretek.shifting_stone_craft: Shift + right-click in the air: portable crafting table
tooltip.futuretek.solar_2: 32 TU/t in daylight, a little at night
tooltip.futuretek.solar_3: 128 TU/t in daylight, a little at night
tooltip.futuretek.sorting_conduit: Right-click: filter · the chest it touches gets ONLY those items
tooltip.futuretek.soul_core: Nether material for the advanced machines
tooltip.futuretek.spent_coolant_cell: Full of heat: craft it with a water bucket (or let a Reactor Maintainer touching water refill it)
tooltip.futuretek.spent_coolant_cell_30k: Full of heat: craft it with a water bucket
tooltip.futuretek.spent_coolant_cell_60k: Full of heat: craft it with a water bucket
tooltip.futuretek.star_charge:
Light it with redstone or flint and steel: after 4 s it breaks everything within 6 blocks
Nothing is destroyed: all drops fall in the middle · does not break chests and machines
tooltip.futuretek.synthesis_click: Click: create 1 · Shift+click: create a stack
tooltip.futuretek.synthesis_tablet: Right-click: opens the Synthesis Table anywhere
tooltip.futuretek.thermal_centrifuge:
ORE TRIPLING, step 2: purified crushed ore → dust (+ bonus)
Then smelt the dust: 1 raw = 3 ingots!
tooltip.futuretek.tide_amulet:
Right-click: places water (free, infinite)
Right-click on a chemical bath: fills its tank
tooltip.futuretek.tree_farm:
Plants saplings in a 9x9 area around it (one every 3 blocks) and cuts the grown trees
Saplings in the first 4 slots · wood goes to the chest next to it
tooltip.futuretek.verdant_ring: Right-click: on/off · Makes crops and saplings grow faster around you
tooltip.futuretek.vitality_amulet: Right-click: on/off · Restores hunger (16 Essence) and health (32 Essence) over time
tooltip.futuretek.void_catalyst:
Right-click in the air: charge 1→4 (bigger area)
Right-click a block: breaks the area · Shift: only the front layer
All drops go to your inventory · 4 Essence per block
tooltip.futuretek.water_mill: 1 TU/t for each side touching water (max 6)
tooltip.futuretek.wind_mill:
From y 64 up: the higher, the more energy (max 8, x2 in thunderstorms)
Needs free air around it
tooltip.futuretek.windrider_ring:
Right-click: on/off · Lets you fly like in creative
2 Essence per second while flying
